Definition: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff
BiblicalUsage: 1) to breathe, blow; 1a) (Qal) to breathe; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to exhale or breathe; 1b2) to puff, snort; 1b3) to excite, inflame; 1b4) to puff, pant for it; 1b5) to breathe out, utter; 1b6) to blow, blast
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
